name: Naive-N0.5-Flash
purpose: Open-weight 309B MoE built for coding and AI R&D with native 1M context without full-attention layers; the vendor also sells API access at $0.10 / $0.40 / $0.01 per million input / output / cache-read tokens (card).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: MIT licence text read in the repo LICENSE file: use, copy, modify, sell allowed with notice.

architecture.kind: MoE, 39 sliding-window layers plus 9 DeepSeek-sparse-attention layers, no full attention
architecture.attention: SWA window 128 and DSA top-2048, GQA4
architecture.drafter: speculative decoding in the vendor runtime
